## Risks

Note accessibility, security, privacy, licensing, dependency, migration, and unresolved data risks. Write “None identified” where appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no secrets, local configuration, transcripts, or unrelated files.
- [ ] I did not guess changing civic facts; each published fact meets the project's source and verification rules.
- [ ] Images, documents, and other assets have documented reuse rights and attribution where required.
- [ ] The independent-project disclaimer and upstream attribution remain accurate.
- [ ] I ran and reported the relevant checks without claiming checks that did not run.
